title: [Core][Aver] Show my schedule settings - Calendar default ON when remove-default flag is OFF
description: AC 01.2 - Existing BO Calendar default behavior remains ON and applies current teacher.
preconditions:
- Logged in to BO as an Aver user with Lesson Calendar access.
- lesson.lessonmgmt_sf.is_enabled = true.
- lesson.remove_default_teacher_filter.is_enabled = false.
- lesson.limit_teacher_access_other_lessons.is_enabled = false.
- Calendar FILTER_LESSON and ACTIVE_FILTER_LESSON storage are cleared.
- Calendar has schedules assigned to the logged-in teacher and another teacher in accessible scope.
steps_actions:
1. Open BO Lesson Calendar.
2. Open the Calendar filter panel.
3. Observe Show my schedule.
4. Inspect the active teacher filter/request or visible lessons.
steps_result:
1. Calendar loads in BO-calling-SF mode.
2. Filter panel opens successfully.
3. Show my schedule is visible and checked by default.
4. Current teacher id is included in active teacher ids; only schedules assigned to the logged-in teacher are shown.
steps_data:
1. lesson.lessonmgmt_sf.is_enabled = true
2. remove_default_teacher_filter = false
3. limit_teacher_access = false
4. storage = cleared

- lesson.remove_default_teacher_filter.is_enabled = true.

- Calendar FILTER_LESSON and ACTIVE_FILTER_LESSON storage are cleared.

steps_actions:

2. Open the Calendar filter panel.
3. Observe Show my schedule.
4. Inspect active teacher ids.
5. Compare visible schedules.

title: [Core][Aver] Show my schedule settings - Manual toggle ON appends current teacher

title: [Core][Aver] Show my schedule settings - Tenant config switch changes defaults after clearing storage
description: AC 01.3 / AC 02.2 - Default state follows tenant config when local storage does not mask it.
preconditions:
- Same BO user can test both config states.
- Calendar and Lesson List filter storages can be cleared between config changes.
steps_actions:
1. Set remove-default-teacher-filter OFF and open Calendar/Lesson List.
2. Record default Show my schedule and Teachers field.
3. Clear Calendar and Lesson List filter storage.
4. Set remove-default-teacher-filter ON with limited teacher access inactive.
5. Reopen Calendar/Lesson List and inspect defaults.
steps_result:
1. Old/default config opens with current teacher filtering active.
2. Calendar checkbox is checked and Lesson List has current teacher selected.
3. Storage is cleared successfully.
4. New config is active.
5. Calendar checkbox is unchecked and Lesson List Teachers field is empty.
steps_data:
1. storage keys = FILTER_LESSON, ACTIVE_FILTER_LESSON, LESSON_SF_LESSON_FILTER
2. limit_teacher_access = false

title: [Core][Aver] Show my schedule settings - Other Calendar filters remain stable when toggling
description: AC 01.5 - Show my schedule changes teacher filtering only and preserves other selected filters.
preconditions:
- BO Calendar is in BO-calling-SF mode.
- lesson.remove_default_teacher_filter.is_enabled = true.
- Date, location, course/class, lesson status, and type filters have selected values.
steps_actions:
1. Open Calendar filter panel.
2. Toggle Show my schedule ON.
3. Toggle Show my schedule OFF.
4. Inspect other selected filters after each toggle.
5. Inspect resulting Calendar data.
steps_result:
1. Filter panel opens successfully.
2. Only Show my schedule and active teacher ids change.
3. Only Show my schedule and active teacher ids change again.
4. Date, location, course/class, lesson status, and type filters remain selected.
5. Calendar data changes only by teacher filtering within the same date/location/type scope.
